regions.today: Dry with a mix of cloud and sunny spells. Cloud clearing this afternoon to warm sunshine. Highest temperatures of 17 to 22 degrees in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Dry with long clear spells, some cloud in the north of the province. Lowest temperatures of 8 to 13 degrees with light westerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Dry and sunny to start, cloud spreading from the west in the afternoon. Highest temperares of 18 to 23 degrees with light to moderate southwest winds.
